01 · Logo

Boca: o som sai pela verdade

The "ó" of Empório becomes a guitar soundhole; the accent is a pick resting on the rim. A player's detail, drawn friendly. The accent is part of the name, so the mark protects the spelling.

Avatar disc on the wood rail (honey on walnut 4.66)

Avatar · 96 px · social profile

Avatar · 36–40 px · chat header

Favicon · 16–24 px · soundhole + pick only

Wordmark · min 120 px wide

Rules

  • Clear space: 0.5 x ring diameter around the lockup; 0.25 x disc diameter around the icon.
  • Minimums: lockup 96 px wide, secondary 120 px, icon with rosette 40 px, favicon 16 px.
  • The ring is always open: cream or surface shows through. It is a hole, not a dot.
  • It may breathe once, slowly, on the warm-up screen only.

Never

  • Fill the hole, thicken the ring past 1/3 of its radius, or show the rosette under 40 px.
  • Rotate or mirror the accent, or turn it into a note flag or pick triangle.
  • Recolor the disc terracotta, add shadow, bevel or gradient.
  • Add eyes or a smile; spin it as a loader; drop the accent ("Emporio").

Chosen concept (2026-11-05): AI-generated raster images, pending vectorization to SVG with colors locked to brand tokens and Fraunces outlines (identity/logo-directions.md). identity/assets/boca-icon*.svg remain construction references only.

02 · Positioning

A melhor venda é o instrumento que você vai amar tocar.

Para músicos do Centro-Oeste que querem acertar na escolha, a Empório da Música é a loja que fala a verdade sobre instrumentos, até quando a verdade é "esse mais barato resolve".

Promise

Every conversation feels like advice from a musician friend who happens to work at the store.

Point of view

Instrument retail treats beginners as a spec sheet or an upsell target. The right instrument is often the cheaper one, and saying so builds more loyalty than any discount.

Archetype

Everyperson 70%, Sage 30%. "O amigo músico que trabalha na loja": knows the difference between cedro and spruce, and tells you plainly which one you need.

Uma placa pintada e uma conversa

Pairing

Fraunces carries the brand moments (login, warm-up, empty state, tagline). Source Sans 3 carries everything the customer reads in a conversation. The contrast says: a store with history, talking like a person.

Rules

  • ALL CAPS, a third typeface, script fonts.
  • Fraunces 800–900 or 100–300.
  • Anything read or tapped in chat under 16 px.

05 · Visual elements

Papel, madeira e uma linha à mão

Zero photographs in the POC. Warmth comes from generated textures and single-weight line drawings. Textures live on pseudo-elements, so text layers stay flat.

Paper grain

SVG noise, walnut tint, opacity .05, multiply. Cream canvas only. Off in dark mode and under prefers-reduced-data.

Wood grain

Two uneven repeating bands at 3.5% and 2.5% walnut. Login card only (the chat header is the solid wood rail); never behind bubbles, inputs or text under 18 px.

Rosette tile

Soundhole rings at 4% walnut, 96 px tile. The one repeating motif, login and warm-up canvas only.

Line drawings

  • One object per drawing: tuning pegs, rosette, a loose string, a cavaquinho bridge, a piano key edge.
  • Stroke 3 on a 160 canvas, round caps and joins, currentColor (walnut, cream in dark).
  • At most one honey fill, under 20% of the object. Never terracotta.
  • Static, aria-hidden, 50–60% of the container, message in real text below.

06 · Iconography

Lucide, traço 1.75

Outline, rounded, walnut by default. One stroke everywhere (strokeWidth 1.75, absoluteStrokeWidth). Semantic hues only with words. The assistant is never an icon: it is the Boca mark.

07 · Motion

Quase parado, de propósito

Three motions exist. Everything else is still. Under prefers-reduced-motion all three stop and meaning stays in the text.

ring-breathe

scale 1 → 1.04, opacity → .85, 4 s ease-in-out. Warm-up only.

dot-pulse

Honey dots, staggered, 1.2 s. Static full honey when reduced.

Tem sim, chegou essa semana.

fade-arrive

Opacity 0 → 1, rise 4 px, 150 ms, cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1).

10 · Personas

Pra quem a gente fala

Primary

Luísa, 22–28

Self-taught guitarist in Campo Grande. Works by day, practices at night with YouTube lessons. Lives on WhatsApp; buys online when she trusts the seller. Budget around R$ 1.500, maybe in 12x.

Frustration. Listings bury her in specs; clerks push the priciest model.

Aspiration. Someone who understands music, talks like a person and honestly says which instrument fits her.

Trust signals

  • Straight answers and real prices, original next to any discount.
  • Being told "você não precisa gastar mais".

Distrust signals

  • Pushy upsell and fake urgency.
  • Robotic replies; jargon without explanation.

11 · Voice

Descontraída, musical, curiosa

On an honest, knowledgeable base. "Informal mas profissional, como um amigo que entende de música."

Takamine GD20, boa escolha pra quem curte um folk! Sai R$ 2.199, ou R$ 2.089,05 no PIX. Você toca mais dedilhado ou batida?

Descontraída

Natural WhatsApp Portuguese: "pra", "tá", "a gente". At most one colloquialism per bubble.

Musical

Translates specs into sound and comfort. Every spec gets a one-clause plain translation.

Curiosa

One genuine question per reply, always last, only if it changes the recommendation.

Never

  • "Fico feliz em ajudar", "ótima pergunta", "espero ter ajudado", "prezado(a)".
  • Markdown, lists or walls of text in chat.
  • Em dash as punctuation; "vc", "pq", "blz"; emoji.
  • Price, stock, promo or deadline without a system check.
  • Announcing honesty ("vou ser sincero").
  • An invented human name for the assistant.

Always

  • 1 to 3 short bubbles per reply, 1–2 sentences each.
  • Promo as original + % + final: "De R$ 1.299 por R$ 1.104,15, 15% off".
  • The cheaper option first when it fits, and why.
  • "Vou confirmar" or a handoff when the system has no answer.
  • "Você", "a Empório", "Empório" with the accent.
  • Honest answer to "você é robô?", with the offer of a person.
Do

Pro seu nível, esse de R$ 849 dá conta tranquilo.

Don't

Recomendo fortemente investir no modelo premium.

Do

Poxa, entendo a chateação. Já registrei e alguém da loja te responde em até 24 horas úteis.

Don't

Lamentamos o ocorrido e pedimos desculpas pelo transtorno causado.
